title: Payment Instruments Counted Toward the Advance on a Respite and Short-Term Stay
content:
**Rule.** The receipts counted toward the advance on a booked stay under the Respite and Short-Term Stay Agreement are chosen by one of three methods: when the stay shows a returned payment, only payments by debit card, credit card, certified check or insurer transfer are counted; when the stay shows no returned payment and the guest's independent living account shows one in the last twelve months, the payments less the returned payments are counted without personal checks; otherwise the payments less the returned payments are counted.

**Terms.**
- The payments and returned payments are those posted on the stay's own ledger.
- Under the first method the receipts counted are the total of the stay's payments made with one of the four named instruments; no other instrument enters the total.
- Under the second method the receipts counted are the stay's payments less its returned payments, leaving out every payment made by personal check.
- "The guest's independent living account shows one" means a returned-payment entry posted in the last twelve months on the account of the guest's Larkspur Independent Living Residency Agreement.

## Instruments by method

| Instrument of a payment on the stay | Stay shows a returned payment | No return on the stay, return on the independent living account in the last 12 months | Otherwise |
|---|---|---|---|
| Debit card | Counted | Counted | Counted |
| Credit card | Counted | Counted | Counted |
| Certified or cashier's check | Counted | Counted | Counted |
| Insurer transfer | Counted | Counted | Counted |
| One-time ACH debit | Not counted | Counted | Counted |
| Personal check | Not counted | Not counted | Counted |
| Returned payments | Not deducted | Deducted | Deducted |

## Hypothetical illustrations

A stay shows a credit card payment of 800.00, a personal check of 600.00 and a one-time ACH debit of 300.00.
- If the ACH debit was returned: the stay shows a returned payment, so only the card payment counts: 800.00.
- If nothing was returned on the stay but the guest's independent living account shows a return two months ago: 800.00 plus 300.00, the check left out: 1,100.00.
- If nothing was returned anywhere: 800.00 plus 600.00 plus 300.00, that is 1,700.00.
